sn15.12:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || Anamataggāyam bhikkhave saṃsāro || pe|| || Yam bhikkhave passeyyātha sukhitaṃ sajjitaṃ niṭṭham ettha gantabbaṃ Amhehi pi evarūpam paccanubhūtaṃ iminā dīghena addhunāti Tam kissa hetu || || Anamataggāyam bhikkhave saṃsāro pubbākoṭi na paññāyati || pe || || alām vimuccitunti || || Dutiyaṃ || ||
